prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: rear-end collision in Conroe, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported whiplash. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1414; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was stopped in the right lane of northbound traffic on a Conroe, Texas roadway when the vehicle directly behind, operated by Driver 2, struck the rear of Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 1 reported neck pain consistent with whiplash and stated that the impact was sudden and forceful. A Passenger was also present in Driver 1's vehicle at the time of the collision, and both the responding officer and independent witnesses confirmed that the Passenger was seated inside the vehicle when the impact occurred. Driver 2 acknowledged following too closely and did not dispute how the collision happened. Several witnesses and photographs taken at the scene are consistent with the account given by both drivers. The damage to the rear of Driver 1's vehicle lines up with the reported point and force of impact. Officers found no indication of prior damage to either vehicle. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy covering the vehicle. Whether the reported neck injury was caused by this collision has not yet been determined and will require further medical evaluation.
